headline: GOLDSEEK: JUNIOR MINERS HAVE THE BEST CHARTS IN ANY SECTOR — BIGGEST MOVE STILL AHEAD AFTER JOBS-SHOCK SELLOFF
snippet: A Sunday technical analysis piece on GoldSeek argues that junior gold and silver miners present 'the best charts in any sector' following Friday's jobs-data selloff, with long-term bases intact and the biggest move in mining equities still ahead. The author's case: gold remains above $4,300, AISC stays below $2,000, margins near record levels — and the structural bull thesis is unchanged by a single macro print. Long-term chart patterns in the GDXJ universe have improved, not broken, on this correction.

headline: ONTARIO JUNIOR PULLS 61,389 G/T SILVER (1,790 OZ/TON) AT CASTLE EAST — COBALT CAMP VEIN SYSTEM EXTENDS
snippet: Nord Precious Metals Mining Inc. (TSXV: NTH) extended the Robinson high-grade silver vein at its Castle East project in Ontario's historic Cobalt-Gowganda district, returning 6.65m at 2,848 g/t Ag — including a peak of 61,389 g/t (1,790.8 oz/ton) over 0.30m. The company operates TTL Laboratories, the only permitted high-grade milling facility in the Cobalt Camp, and uses its Re-2Ox hydrometallurgical process to recover silver alongside cobalt and nickel from complex ores with typical arsenic barriers eliminated.

headline: BARRICK IN TALKS TO CREATE $30B AFRICA GOLD TITAN WITH ENDEAVOUR — LONDON LISTING UNDER STUDY
snippet: Barrick Mining is exploring an all-share merger of its African operations with Endeavour Mining to create a London-listed gold and copper company valued at approximately $30 billion — potentially the largest mining deal of 2026. Under the structure, Barrick would retain its Toronto listing as a holding company with stakes in New York-listed North American operations and the new London entity housing mines in Mali, Tanzania, Zambia, DRC, and Ivory Coast. Sources say discussions are exploratory with no announcement imminent.

headline: YUKON METALS (CSE: YMC) LAUNCHES 5,000M COPPER-GOLD DRILL AT TWO PORPHYRY TARGETS IN THE YUKON
snippet: Yukon Metals Corp. (CSE: YMC) has two diamond drill rigs operating across its fully funded AZ and Birch copper-gold properties in the Yukon, with first core produced at AZ on May 28. The 5,000m program — 2,000m at AZ and 3,000m at Birch — is supported by a 3D Induced Polarization survey targeting porphyry zones, plus drone aeromagnetics and geochemical sampling. The AZ property targets a copper-gold system in a highly prospective Yukon Tanana terrane setting.

headline: CHILE COPPER HITS SEVEN-YEAR LOW IN APRIL AS ESCONDIDA OUTPUT FALLS 16%; ECONOMY CONTRACTS FOURTH MONTH
snippet: Chile's copper output fell 13.8% year-on-year to 399,954 metric tonnes in April 2026 — the weakest April in at least seven years — as lower ore grades hit BHP's Escondida mine (-16% to 101,600t) and the Collahuasi joint venture (-11% to 31,400t). Output has now declined for seven consecutive months on a rolling 12-month basis. Chile's April IMACEC economic activity indicator contracted 1.2%, a fourth consecutive monthly fall, as an 11.8% mining sector slump dragged broader activity below forecasts.

headline: JUNE 30 DEADLINE: WHITE HOUSE MUST RULE ON PHASED 15–30% TARIFFS ON REFINED COPPER IMPORTS
snippet: A June 2026 White House fact sheet confirmed the Commerce Secretary must deliver a copper market update to President Trump by June 30, triggering a decision on whether to expand existing Section 232 duties: a phased universal tariff on refined copper at 15% from January 2027, rising to 30% from January 2028. The 50% tariff on semi-finished copper products (pipes, wires, rods) already took effect August 2025. The June 30 call is being closely watched across the junior copper mining sector for its project-level economics implications.

headline: FORTUNE BAY + MANHATTAN URANIUM BEGIN 5,000M, 25-TARGET ATHABASCA BASIN DRILL CAMPAIGN
snippet: Fortune Bay Corp. and Manhattan Uranium Discovery Corp. have commenced a fully funded 5,000m drill program targeting up to 25 basement-hosted uranium targets at the Murmac and Strike projects near Uranium City, northern Saskatchewan. The program follows a 2024 Murmac discovery hole that returned 8.4m at 0.3% U₃O₈ — including 1.2m at 1.79% U₃O₈ — and the historically mined Strike Zone's 0.6–3.5% U₃O₈ grades. Manhattan holds $11.5M in cash and is running parallel drill programs on the Colorado Plateau and Nevada.

headline: LITHIUM BUST IS OVER: CME HYDROXIDE FUTURES UP 86% IN 2026, BACK ABOVE $20,000/TONNE FOR FIRST TIME SINCE 2023
snippet: The CME lithium hydroxide contract has surged 86% since January 1, 2026, trading back above $20,000 per metric tonne for the first time since late 2023 — confirming the end of a three-year post-peak bust. Drivers include energy-storage restocking, surging Chinese EV exports, and record CME contract volume (8,296t in the first full week of January). Citi has a 3-month upside target of $32,000/t, though analysts expect a renewed supply response to cap the cycle further out.

headline: NORTHERN STAR GROWS TO 88.9 MILLION OUNCES AFTER 26% RESOURCE JUMP — POGO MINE DOUBLES IN ALASKA
snippet: Northern Star Resources (ASX: NST) updated its Mineral Resources to 88.9 million ounces (up 26%) and Ore Reserves to 28.4 million ounces (up 27%) as at March 31, 2026, after accounting for full-year mining depletion. The Pogo mine in Alaska was the standout, roughly doubling in resource size following a 305,000m drill programme in 2025. Northern Star's $225M FY26 exploration programme achieved a discovery cost of approximately $19 per ounce added — industry-leading efficiency for a multi-million-ounce global portfolio.

headline: TREATY CREEK 2026 DRILL SEASON BEGINS: TUDOR GOLD TARGETS PERFECTSTORM ZONE IN BC GOLDEN TRIANGLE
snippet: Tudor Gold Corp. and partner Teuton Resources (TSX-V: TUO) have two diamond drill rigs operating at the Treaty Creek gold-copper-silver project in British Columbia's Golden Triangle, targeting a minimum 10,000m program for 2026. Phase 1 covers 2,000m in the CBS Zone; Phase 2 plans 8,000m in the Perfectstorm Zone — a high-grade corridor adjacent to the Goldstorm Deposit that has yielded some of the highest-grade gold intercepts in Golden Triangle history. Results are expected through the summer season.
